heading: Repealed. Oct. 12, 1949, ch. 681, title V, § 531(b)(41), 63 Stat. 840

notes.text: Section 853m, act June 3, 1948, ch. 390, § 14, 62 Stat. 299, related to retirement for disability. See section 1201 et seq. of Title 10, Armed Forces.
Section 853n, act June 3, 1948, ch. 390, § 15, 62 Stat. 299, related to computation of service for retirement purposes. See sections 1401 et seq., 6321 et seq., and 6371 et seq. of Title 10.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 1949, see section 533(a) of act Oct. 12, 1949, set out as an Effective Date of 1949 Amendment note under section 854a of this title.
